title: P00 opt-in rootless Docker Python syntax broker with cgroup and scope checks
summary: Implemented a default-disabled rootless Docker Python fixture syntax-only broker. It rebuilds the job from independently trusted P00 task/workspace scope, requires owner-bound Unix socket, daemon rootless status, cgroup v2/systemd, pre-cached digest-pinned official Python image, no network/host mounts/privileges and bounded CPU/memory/PIDs. Candidate bytecode is never executed; all CLI/daemon interactions are mock tested on Linux/Windows. User host daemon, OS isolation and autonomous code repair remain unverified.
migration_notes: No user data changes. Docker runtime is default-disabled; image install/pre-caching and rootless host provisioning require separate operator action.
